records.notes: Target aneurysm-wall and blood assays are RT-qPCR only; 16S community sequencing was restricted to stool.
Primary and replication splits of the COPDGene cohort; eight explicitly removed genera logged as flagged.
Only placenta/fetal membrane and cord-blood genera; maternal gut, breast milk, skin and infant stool excluded.
Follicular-fluid microbiota measured by targeted real-time PCR panel only; no microbial community sequencing.
SourceTracker assesses contamination from sequenced PBS controls; check final treatment against published source fractions.
Lactobacillus, Veillonella and Mycoplasma OTUs were judged falsely flagged due to sample-to-control crossover and retained by authors. Propionibacterium removed.
Serum EV results only; a separate brain-tissue analysis is not pooled into this blood record.
Healthy mid-gestational AF profiling retained; infected positive-control AF taxa excluded. All four environmental target detections interpreted as contamination.
Primary nonmalignant lung specimens with smaller paired tumour subset; shared-control-OTU removal was a sensitivity analysis.
Human 16S thyroid results only; isolated Escherichia strain and animal/cell perturbations excluded.
Escherichia/Shigella composite represented once as Escherichia.
16S DNA profiles plus host whole-transcriptome mining; control-only genera and culture-only isolates excluded.
Shotgun chorionic-villus profiles only; cultured fetal-membrane organisms excluded. Authors attribute all named shotgun genera to contamination.
Known-contaminant column preserved as flags; remaining detections do not establish resident blood microbes. Authors reject support for a healthy resident microbiome.
29 MI and 19 healthy controls in Lanzhou; possible shared team/healthy-control recruitment with PMC9577097 requires participant-ID audit; not deduplicated based on institution alone.
Mixed public RNA mining and own 16S cohorts. Exact matching of negative controls to all public cohorts remains a human-check priority.
Human autopsy lung methods comparison. Main text/supplement text lacks extractable target bacterial genus names; genus-level figures require visual adjudication.
Both methods profiled circulating blood. Supplement Table 4 core genera and Table 6 nonzero shotgun-only abundance columns used because main text lacks named genera.
PCR controls had <1000 reads and no amplification bands; environmental controls electrophoresis only. Taxa with <=3 reads or unverified by mbodymap removed; Planococcus validated.
Only IntraCCA tissue genera retained; bile-only genera and biletype biomarkers excluded. Multi-study reuse needs linkage audit.
Virome-only amniotic-fluid profiling; no bacterial community results.
Negative-control-only Casaltella, Acinetobacter and Rhodobacter not attributed to target AF. Reagent dsDNase treatment is not computational contaminant removal.
Only pancreatic tissue community results; oral-only genera excluded. Composite rhizobial label counts once.

Only amniotic-fluid community extracted. Shared maternal/neonatal prose could not establish AF-specific taxa. Visually verified supplementary PDF Figure S6 panel A (page 9), with S5 panels A/B corroborating Corynebacterium/Anoxybacillus. S8-S10 contain no genus labels. Manual figure transcription in S990.md is explicitly derived, not original machine-extracted text; human review priority.
Plasma sequencing eligible but text/supplements give only phylum-level plasma results; fecal genus lists excluded.
Own Slovak breast RNA-seq plus Chinese public breast RNA-seq comparison; simulated human-read controls are not experimental negative controls.
Blood leukocyte WGS mining plus RNA-seq validation; PD-MDCNC primary and PPMI external cohorts. Published contaminant list plus correlated taxa removed.
Full breast tissue supplement abundance table used; only columns with nonzero target tissue values retained, excluding oral/urine tables.

Research profiling of maternal blood during PPROM, not a diagnostic sepsis series. Authors state no patients who developed sepsis were captured (main text line 111). Fifteen percent had clinical chorioamnionitis and nearly all received prophylactic antibiotics; retain this mixed obstetric context for human scope review. Two blood genera named; no available text supplement.
Human liver 16S results only; colony sequencing and mouse/cell experiments excluded.
Human HCC/peritumoral/normal profiles only; mouse gut genera excluded.
Yersinia and Staphylococcus infection pathway labels are not microbial detections and were excluded.
Orbital adipose 16S profiling, separate from host scRNA-seq. Main figure caption names only the ANPR composite; other genus labels require visual review.
PCR water controls not sequenced, but paraffin/extraction blanks sequenced; overall sequenced-control classification reflects the latter.
Own human HCC 2bRAD-M profile plus TCGA BIC external microbial validation; mouse and NK-cell experimental results excluded.
Own RNA-seq microbial mining with shotgun validation; PCR-only controls not evidence of sequenced negative controls.
TCGA microbial profiles with separate FISH/IHC validation; no new sequenced tissue cohort. Compare cohort with existing ACC reanalyses before final models.
Blood metagenomic profiling in leukemia-associated febrile neutropenia, a suspected systemic-infection cohort.
Same research team as PMC12034738, but Gansu People’s Hospital (24+24) versus Qinghai People’s Hospital (10+10); no confirmed sample reuse.
Peripheral lung tissue only. Lactobacillus removed as control contaminant; lung source-model taxa included only where tissue occurrence explicit.
Only TCGA-LUSC microbial results used. WIS paraffin controls described for upstream dataset do not constitute same-cohort TCGA controls.
70 ACS, 70 CCS and 70 healthy controls. Same regional research team as PMC9176212; exact participant overlap not established by shared methods citation.

Intact-bacterial-cell blood extraction plus supplementary blood genus/species tables; literature brain/oral taxa excluded. No-template-control evidence is from qPCR, not evidence that library blanks were sequenced.
NCI-MD 16S discovery and TCGA RNA-seq validation. Removed control-associated genera flagged. Link overlap with other NCI-MD lung reports before final models.
Own 2bRAD-M lung tissue microbiota; PBS culture and FISH controls do not establish sequencing negative controls.
Intra-amniotic infection/early-onset neonatal sepsis proof-of-concept study: resolve diagnostic-infection scope before inclusion.

Intrahepatic metatranscriptomic community profiling with blank-informed WNS filtering. Enterobacter/Cronobacter reference-protein homology labels were excluded as they do not establish organism detection.
Own pancreatic 16S cohort; public GEO used for host autophagy expression only. Control-derived 99th-percentile thresholds applied.
Own 2bRAD-M HCC profiles; control tube described but no explicit control-read result in main text.
Lung tissue 16S genera only; experimental LPS sources not counted as detections.

Multicountry human liver biopsy cohort; controls sequenced, contamination considered negligible rather than taxa removed. Total bacterial load assessment described in supplementary qPCR/control comparison.
Published breast-tissue datasets pooled; primary-study overlap requires resolution before final analysis. Gut-only genera excluded.
